title: Bug: soft backend stack key material not wiped
description: In wp11_backend_soft.c, two categories of sensitive material are left on the stack without zeroing before return: (1) The 512-byte RSA verify plaintext buffer 'out[512]' used in soft_verify RSA_PKCS path -- decrypted plaintext sits on the stack after the comparison. (2) SHA-256 digest buffers 'uint8_t digest[WC_SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]' in soft_sign and soft_verify ECDSA paths. These are not wiped before the function returns. Key material on the stack can be recovered from subsequent stack frames or core dumps. Fix: add wp11_zero() calls (already used elsewhere in the codebase) on these stack buffers in all early-return and normal-return paths. Use the volatile-cast pattern already established in wp11_keystore.c to prevent dead-store elimination.
